title: Retire unused Nunito loader and two forced share-card fonts

source.ref: Two-design module graph and runtime font tracing audit, 2026-10-23

detail: The Stage loader directly owns all five active share-card faces, including full Nunito Bold for missing glyphs. The old Nunito loader has no runtime importers; only its tests and forced trace config keep Black and Liberation Bold alive (539,944 source bytes total). Remove that obsolete loader and those two unused faces, migrate byte-detachment/cache/retry and trace-scope tests to the active loader, retain Nunito Bold and license, and correct historical LIVE-216 preservation premise. Twenty-two focused tests pass, including real 1200x630 JPEG rendering and non-Latin fallback. Whole-tree typecheck, merged-Home focused verification and a new Frequency artifact build must pass before closure; no production performance claim or deployment.

verify.evidence: Open pending whole-tree TypeScript and Frequency compile/artifact gates after removing obsolete loader and forced tracing entries. Focused 22 tests and lint pass.
